context.passage:
Spotlight on Veraride Ltd.
To get to and from work, Mr. Tillett had to
take a total of four buses. With bus fares
increasing almost annually, Mr. Tillett, after
five years of riding the bus, decided to find a
less costly means of transportation, That is
when he learned about Veraride Ltd. from a
colleague. Today, Mr. Tillett bikes to and from
the Arington Hotel in downtown Belize City.
Veraride, whose staff consists solely of
volunteers, collects donated bikes. These are
repaired by volunteers and then sold at
affordable prices. Veraride donates 70 percent
of its revenue to charitable organizations and
invests the remainder in the upkeep of its
facilities in Belmopan, Belize City, and other
locations in Belize.
Those wishing to donate or volunteer their
services are encouraged to contact the
organization by phone, 08 01555, or e-mail,
help @veraride.org.bz. For more information
visit www. veraride.org.bz.
( http:/www.veraride.org.bz/initiatives
History | Initiatives | Volunteering | Donate
Vera Perdomo used to use public transportation regularly to commute to her workplace at
Haylock Memorial Hospital. But she soon realized that the fares were taking a substantial
amount out of her paycheck, so she switched from taking the bus to riding a bicycle and began
to enjoy significant savings. Ms. Perdomo knew her fellow Belmopan residents could reap
similar financial benefits if they bicycled more. So, she established the Bikes for Belizeans
program, in which she and other volunteers refurbish used bicycles and sell them at low cost to
locals. Ms. Perdomo then became aware that many riders wanted to learn bicycle repair skills,
so she opened her first storefront, Veraride Ltd., in her hometown.
While Bikes for Belizeans remains the main initiative at our Veraride locations throughout
Belize, we are now well beyond just the sale of secondhand bikes. We now offer such
programmes as Fundamentals of Cycling, which teaches children bicycle handling and safety
skills, and Nuts and Bolts, in which participants learn to perform bike repairs. We also offer our
Caring and Sharing seminars, which encourage drivers and cyclists to share the road
responsibly. Our most recent initiative is Bikelane, which calls for the creation of dedicated bike
lanes in Belize’s major cities within the next twenty years.
108
Government of Belize
Ministry of Road Transport
is pleased to present this
Certificate of Recognition
to
Veraride Ltd.
The award recognises your commitment to teaching bicycle mechanics,
promoting road safety and road courtesy, and securing the well-being
of our youngest cyclists. Most important, it honours your original and
ongoing initiative to provide an affordable means of transport to
Belizeans for the past ten years.
Marelys BAIOW
Marelys Barrow, Transportation Minister
¢ 1S3L
context.passage_translation:
聚焦 Veraride Ltd。
为了上下班，Tillett 先生不得不乘坐四辆公交车。随着公交票价几乎每年都在上涨，Tillett 先生在骑公交车五年后，决定寻找一种成本更低的交通方式，这时他从一位同事那里了解到了 Veraride Ltd.。如今，Tillett 先生骑自行车往返于 Belize City 市中心的 Arington Hotel。
Veraride 的员工完全由志愿者组成，他们收集捐赠的自行车。这些自行车由志愿者进行修理，然后以实惠的价格出售。Veraride 将其收入的 70% 捐赠给慈善机构，并将剩余部分投资于其在 Belmopan、Belize City 以及伯利兹其他地点的设施维护。
希望捐款或志愿服务的人士，请致电 08 01555 或发送电子邮件至 help@veraride.org.bz 联系该组织。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.veraride.org.bz。
( http:/www.veraride.org.bz/initiatives
历史 | 活动 | 志愿服务 | 捐赠
Vera Perdomo 过去经常乘坐公共交通工具到她在 Haylock Memorial Hospital 的工作地点通勤。但她很快意识到票价占用了她工资的很大一部分，于是她从坐公交车转为骑自行车，并开始享受可观的节省。Perdomo 女士知道她的同胞们如果骑自行车更多，也可以获得类似的经济利益。于是，她创立了“Bikes for Belizeans”（为伯利兹人而建的自行车）项目，她和其他志愿者在那里翻新二手自行车，并以低成本出售给当地人。随后，Perdomo 女士了解到许多骑车的人想学习自行车修理技能，于是她在自己的家乡开设了第一家店面——Veraride Ltd。
虽然“Bikes for Belizeans”仍然是我们 Veraride 在伯利兹各地的主要项目，但我们现在已经远远超出了仅仅销售二手自行车的范畴。我们现在提供诸如“Fundamentals of Cycling”（骑行基础），该课程教授儿童自行车操控和安全技能；以及“Nuts and Bolts”，参与者可以在其中学习进行自行车修理。我们还提供“Caring and Sharing”研讨会，鼓励司机和骑车人负责任地共享道路。我们最近的倡议是 Bikelane，呼吁在未来二十年内为伯利兹的主要城市创建专用的自行车道。
108
伯利兹政府
道路运输部
荣幸地向
Veraride Ltd.呈献本《认可证书》。
该奖项表彰贵组织致力于教授自行车机械知识、促进道路安全和路权意识，以及保障我们最年轻骑车人的福祉。最重要的是，它表彰了贵组织过去十年以来为伯利兹人提供经济实惠的交通工具所做出的原创和持续的努力。
Marelys BAIOW
Marelys Barrow，运输部长
¢ 1S3L
